eps.ov: Shugen and Jikka are sent to Shinsenkyo, while Gabimaru and his companions battle Aza Chobe and Toma.
Aza Chobe and Gabimaru lose themselves in battle, but Mei stops their fight.
While Aza Chobe battles Rien, Gabimaru regains his memories and begins training in the use of tao.
Sagiri believes Shugen will be an ally and eagerly anticipates the expedition's arrival, but Shion is skeptical.
As the expeditioners prepare, Gabimaru asks Mei if she's sure she wants to leave the island with them.
Gabimaru's group finally enters the sacred mountain, but the Tensen can see everything they're up to.
Gantetsusai and Fuchi struggle against Tao Fa, but they seem to be enjoying themselves.
When Tao Fa asks Ju Fa for help, Ju Fa recalls the time they spent together.
The expeditioners work together to take on Tao Fa and Ju Fa, who have undergone Kishikai transformations.
Shion and Nurugai take on Zhu Jin, but both sides lack the ability to finish the other off.
Gabimaru recalls the days he spent with Yui. How will his battle against Rien end?
As Gabimaru and his companions finish their respective battles, the additional expedition arrives.
